description: This PHP source file defines the compose email functionality for the SuiteCRM project, including functions for initializing the compose window, generating data packages for emails, handling reply/forward actions, and integrating with various modules such as Cases, KBDocuments, and Quotes. It also manages interactions with inbound emails and external data retrieval to support email composition features.

methods.name: initFullCompose
methods.description: Prepares and outputs the full compose email window, either as a JSON object for AJAX calls or as embedded JavaScript for full page loads.

methods.name: generateComposeDataPackage
methods.description: Creates a data package required for the email compose interface, supporting different contexts such as new emails, replies, forwards, and module-specific macros.

methods.name: getQuotesRelatedData
methods.description: Retrieves related data for quote records to facilitate email composition with pre-filled details.
